editorial.note: Muziek maken betekende in de 17de eeuw harmonie voortbrengen. Daarom liet de rijke koopman David Leeuw zijn gezin al musicerend portretteren, als verbeelding van het harmonieuze gezinsleven.
Waardijns waren de opzichters en bestuurders van het lakengilde. Tot hun taken behoorden het keuren van de weefsels, het bepalen van de wolsoorten en de manier van weven en verven.

editorial.note: After suffering financial difficulties in the 1650s, Rembrandt moved to a rental house on the Rozengracht. The Amsterdam élite no longer knocked on his door as often as they had done before.

151696.title: Isaac and Rebecca, Known as ‘The Jewish Bride’
151696.creator: Rembrandt van Rijn

editorial.note: To prevent being killed and having his wife captured by King Abimelech, Isaac concealed his love for Rebecca by pretending they were brother and sister. However, their intimacy betrayed them when they thought they were not being spied on.

editorial.note: The regentesses Clara Abba, Elisabeth van Duynen, and Agatha Munter administered Amsterdam’s leper house, a charitable institution.

151918.title: Banquet at the Crossbowmen’s Guild in Celebration of the Treaty of Münster
151918.creator: Bartholomeus van der Helst

editorial.note: 18 June 1648: a banquet is taking place at the Amsterdam crossbowmen’s guild. The occasion was the signing of the Treaty of Münster, which marked an end to the war with Spain.

151938.title: Michiel Adriaenszoon de Ruyter and his Family
151938.creator: Juriaen Jacobsz.

editorial.note: Michiel Adriaansz de Ruyter with his family, by Jurriaen Jacobson, 1662. De Ruyter's glorious career as admiral brought him and his family social status in the Republic and abroad, as this family portrait shows.

152061.title: Four Regents and the ‘House Father’ of the Amsterdam Lepers’ Asylum
152061.creator: Werner van den Valckert

editorial.note: The men wearing hats are the regents, or buitenvaders, of the Amsterdam Lepers’ Asylum, which cared for people suffering from leprosy and other ailments.

152118.title: Reception of the Dutch ambassador Hieronymus van Beverningk by the Spanish queen-regent Maria-Anna of Austria, 2 March 1671
152118.creator: Caspar Netscher

editorial.note: Reception of the Dutch ambassador Hieronymus van Beverningk by the Spanish queen-regent Maria-Anna of Austria, 2 March 1671, by Caspar Netscher. The expansionist policies of France's King Louis XIV forced the Republic to look for allies.

152126.title: Magdalena Moons Begging her Fiancé to Postpone the Storming of Leiden, 1574
152126.creator: Simon Opzoomer

editorial.note: In the spring of 1574, the inhabitants of Leiden were starving because of the long siege by the Spaniards. The Spanish general Valdez decided to invade the weakened town.

152262.title: Frederick Henry, his Consort Amalia of Solms, and their Three Youngest Daughters
152262.creator: Gerard van Honthorst

editorial.note: Amalia commissioned this painting for the palace of Huis ten Bosch. It hung next to portraits of her eldest, already married children, William II and his English bride, Mary, and Louise Henriette and Frederick William I of Brandenburg.
